**Triage — graded.** `documentation` · `priority:p3` · `pm:queue` · `domain:skills`. Adopted as filed.

## Verified at `origin/main` — both halves, decisively

✅ `stack.zod.ts` — the AI collections of `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` are exactly `agents`, `tools`, `skills`. No model registry, no knowledge sources.
✅ `ModelRegistrySchema` is referenced in **only two files across `packages/**/*.ts`**: its own `model-registry.zod.ts` and its own test. ⇒ No stack key, no lint rule, no CLI command reaches it.

⇒ The card's central claim is not an interpretation: a model-registry entry is **not an input `os validate` can receive**, so the sentence at `:396` promises a check with no path to run. And `:332` of the same file already says so. ⭐ A file that contradicts itself sends the reader whichever way they happen to read first — the same shape I graded on #14798 this shift, where a live line and a line its own file declared overturned sat fourteen lines apart.

## Scope — terminal

Two short deletions: "or a model-registry entry" from `:396`, and "/ model" from `:404`. Shrink-only, no re-wrap.

⚠️ Governed `skills/**` ⇒ **draft PR, human merge**. ⛔ Do not flip ready, enqueue or merge.
✅ Shrink-only is comfortably inside the ratchet — the card measured `['skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md', 6806]` against a current 5,475 tokens. ⚠️ Re-measure at claim anyway; PR #14819 moved this file today.

⛔ **Do not name a replacement validator.** If a model-registry entry is meant to be author-validated by something, that something must come from a measured path — the card looked and found none. ⛔ Do not invent one, and ⛔ do not add a "not currently validated" caveat either; the fix is to stop promising, not to explain the gap.

⛔ Out of scope: #14797's CEL clause one sentence below (fixed by PR #14819, `pm:dispatched`), `skills/README.md`, and #14462's `SKILL_MAP` — a different defect in a different lane's file.

⚠️ **Sequence after PR #14819.** Same file, adjacent lines; landing in parallel is a conflict for nothing.

✅ Dedup accepted — 15 results read, with #14797, #14462/#14466/#14565, #14461 and #14305 each distinguished on file or claim.

**Brief in one paragraph:** re-measure at the dev's head (at `b1d49b3940` the two sentences sit at `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md:396-397` and `:404`, the contradiction partner at `:332`; the file is 417 lines, ceiling row 6806 tokens); the two deletions the card names, shrink-only, no re-wrap, no other sentence touched; the `os validate` fence comment at `:400` ("Zod schema + CEL predicate validation + bindings") is a judgement call for the dev — if the same fence is the shared wording every domain skill uses, it stays; if it is this file's own wording, the AI domain has no CEL site (PR #14819) and the dev says which it is in the PR body either way; the seat re-measures the token count and the line count at review; the internal-pm decision frame is pasted verbatim in the brief, read from `origin/main` in the dispatch minute by its anchor sentences.

3. `packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts` - parses `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema`: `safeParse` at :187, the two authoring-lint passes at :184-185.

## Reverse verification

Run from the committed state, under a trap on EXIT INT TERM restoring the absolute path:

- Mutation leg - "or a model-registry entry" re-inserted at :396; proved on disk before measuring: `grep -c` of that phrase moved 0 to 1, and `git hash-object` moved to 3cfae14e1c, away from the HEAD blob 9f5231126e.
- Reading - the file's measured token count rises 5467 to 5473 (the six tokens this half removes). The ratchet stays GREEN in that state, because 5473 is far under the 6806 ceiling. That is the honest reading and I am not dressing it up: the ratchet prices size, it cannot see the false claim. What moved is the measured count, not a verdict.
- Restore leg - `git checkout HEAD --` on the absolute path; `git hash-object` returned 9f5231126eab1f93aa5d1a142d4a78867cf8275f, equal to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` clean, and the ratchet re-read 5467.

## Judgement calls

1. No re-flow. The file wraps prose at 80 columns. :396 shrinks 79 to 53 characters and :397 keeps five words ("author-time gate before reporting done:", 39 characters) - not an orphan. :404 shrinks 76 to 68 with a full 80-character :405 behind it. Re-flowing either would edit a line the card did not name and cascade through the paragraph. So: two intra-line deletions, zero line-count change.
2. The `os validate` fence comment at :400 stays - the seat's reading is confirmed by measurement. The identical line, byte for byte, is at skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:411. It is shared gate wording, not this file's claim, and the sentence right after it here already says this domain has no CEL site. Editing it in one of the two files would fork wording the published catalog shares. Observation only, no change.
3. No replacement validator named, no "not currently validated" caveat added. The triage was explicit on both; the fix is to stop promising.
4. No changeset, `skip-changeset` applied. The diff publishes nothing from any released package. Labels were written through MCP after a repo-scoped REST read probe returned 403 for this session, so the additive endpoint was unavailable: I read the current set, wrote the union, and read it back comparatively. Read-back shows documentation, size/xs, skip-changeset, needs:contract-review - every union member present, nothing stripped; documentation was added concurrently by a labeler, not by me.
5. Nothing else in the published catalog makes this claim. Swept skills/** for `model-registry`, `model registry`, `ModelRegistry`: remaining hits are :301 and :405 here, skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md:422 and the generated pointer at skills/objectstack-ai/references/_index.md:18. None promises a check, so the deletion strands no instruction.

## Out-of-scope findings

None to file. Two observations for the seat, neither a card:

1. skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md:400, verbatim: `os validate     # Zod schema + CEL predicate validation + bindings (no artifact)`. Byte-identical to skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:411. Shared wording, deliberately untouched per the brief. Recording it so the measurement is on the record rather than in my head.
2. `ModelRegistrySchema` is NOT a dead surface, and I want that on the record so nobody reads this PR as evidence that it is. docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json:526 already states it, verbatim: "ModelRegistrySchema (packages/spec/src/ai/model-registry.zod.ts) and ConversationSessionSchema (conversation.zod.ts) have NO open-framework runtime consumer - /ai/models and /ai/conversations/* are served only by cloud service-ai (enumerated in cloud's ai-route-ledger.ts, #3718)". It is also a published export (packages/spec/api-surface/ai.json:118) with generated reference docs. So the schema has a consumer, in another repo - which is exactly why `os validate`, an in-repo stack-definition gate, has no path to it. This corroborates the card and is an argument against filing any enforce-or-remove card off the back of this flight.

## Landing posture

Governed surface (skills/**): PR left as a draft. Not flipped ready, not enqueued, no auto-merge, no reviewers requested, no approving review, nothing merged. `needs:contract-review` is on it for the seat's contract read.
